Q1_protonation_barriers.conclusion: successive protonation lowers the BiPy barrier by about 10 and then 6 kcal/mol

Q2_cc_chemoselectivity.conclusion: BiPy selectivity is kinetic rather than product-thermodynamic

Q4_mechanism.oxygen_lone_pair_role: little change along the key IRC
Q4_mechanism.key_event: one apical P-C(py) bond breaks while the new C-C bond forms

Q5_rate_determining_step.rate_limiting_step: alcohol attack/addition at the phosphonium phosphorus center to form the P(V) species
Q5_rate_determining_step.selectivity_determining_step: intramolecular ligand coupling from the P(V) intermediate
supporting_observations: P(V) intermediate not detected by 31P NMR
